already_done.text: Initial coverage note already published at initiation.
Q2 earnings summary already circulated to the team.

assumptions.text: Data-center demand stays strong through next year.
The competitor note's share-loss claim is not material.
Revised full-year gross margin of approximately 38.5%.

constraints.text: Single-name position must not exceed 3% of portfolio.
Client-facing factual claims must cite primary sources (company releases and filings), never competitor notes.
Any published price target must be accompanied by the export-control risk disclosure.

decisions.rationale: Q2 results beat, 18% guided growth, strong data-center demand.
decisions.text: Initiate coverage at Buy (initiation rating; see errata).

decisions.rationale: 22x multiple applied to the original EPS estimate of $3.82.
decisions.text: Price target $84, at 22x FY+1 EPS of $3.82.
Position size capped at 3% of portfolio.

decisions.rationale: After the guidance cut, upside to the revised target no longer compensates for export-control risk.
EPS estimate cut to $3.05 on revised guidance; multiple unchanged at 22x; 22 x 3.05 = 67.1.
decisions.text: Revised price target $67, at 22x revised FY+1 EPS of $3.05.

errata.note: The scenario materials never named the initiation rating and did not round the target arithmetic (22 x 3.82 = 84.04; 22 x 3.05 = 67.10). Agent A legitimately produced rating 'Buy' and exact figures $84.04 and $67.10. The original ground truth asserted 'Overweight' and $84, which the scenario does not support. Corrections: D1 uses the produced initiation rating (Buy); 'overweight' was replaced by 'buy' in must_mention; X3 covers both labels. Graders: accept $84.04 for $84 and $67.10 for $67 in all items and chains; the difference is rounding only. Recorded before any continuation or grading ran.

evidence.text: Q2 revenue $412M, up 19% year over year; Q2 gross margin 41.2%.
Original full-year guidance: 18% revenue growth, gross margin approximately 41%.
Revised guidance: 11% revenue growth and gross margin approximately 38.5%, citing new export-control restrictions.
Distributor reports data-center orders steady, no cancellations, lead times stable.
Competitor note alleges share loss in AI accelerator sockets, citing no primary data.

must_not_state.text: Full-year revenue growth is 18% (as the current figure).
The initiation rating (Buy) is still the current rating.
The competitor note reported or confirmed the guidance cut, or its share-loss claim is established fact.

next_actions.text: Update the model to the revised guidance and publish the updated note with the $67 target and export-control disclosure.
Seek clarification on the scope of the export controls (affected SKUs) on the next earnings call.

objective: Initiate and then update equity coverage of Northgate Semiconductor (NGS) after a mid-session guidance revision.

open_questions.text: Which product lines or SKUs do the export controls affect? Not specified in the release.
Will Q3 orders show a demand impact from the export controls?
